rules.description: Listening service on TCP port 22, commonly associated with SSH.
rules.exploit: Attempt authentication against the exposed SSH service using credentials or private keys obtained during the assessment.

rules.description: Listening service on TCP port 21, commonly associated with FTP.
rules.exploit: Connect to the FTP service and test for anonymous access or credentials that provide unauthorized file access.

rules.description: Listening service on TCP port 23, commonly associated with Telnet.
rules.exploit: Attempt authentication against the exposed Telnet service and assess whether credentials provide unauthorized shell access.

rules.description: Listening service on TCP port 80, commonly associated with HTTP.
rules.exploit: Enumerate the exposed web application and test its endpoints, authentication, and known attack surface.

rules.description: Listening service on TCP port 443, commonly associated with HTTPS.
rules.exploit: Enumerate the exposed HTTPS application and test its authentication and application attack surface.

rules.description: Listening service on TCP port 3306, commonly associated with MySQL or MariaDB.
rules.exploit: Attempt database authentication using credentials discovered during the assessment and determine whether the database permits unauthorized access.

rules.description: Listening service on TCP port 5432, commonly associated with PostgreSQL.
rules.exploit: Attempt authentication using discovered PostgreSQL credentials and determine whether unauthorized database access is possible.

rules.description: Listening service on TCP port 6379, commonly associated with Redis.
rules.exploit: Connect to the Redis service and test whether it permits unauthenticated access or unauthorized command and data operations.

rules.description: Listening service on TCP port 27017, commonly associated with MongoDB.
rules.exploit: Connect to the MongoDB service and test whether authentication controls prevent unauthorized database access.

rules.description: Local hosts file contents were collected and may disclose internal hostnames or addresses.
rules.exploit: Use discovered internal hostnames and addresses to identify additional systems and services accessible from the compromised host.
